reason: Corrects the wording of two lines of the v0.26.0 release note in all 18 languages, which promised more than holds: the new node line no longer says a diagram reads the same in every language (the name is outside the body, so the body's size does not depend on a translation's length), and the connections line no longer says existing documents keep their connections where they were or that nothing else changes (existing documents are not re-placed, their values and the meaning of their connections are kept, their look changes with the new node; saving one with chosen sides in an older version drops those sides). No behaviour changes and there is nothing new to announce, so no release note of its own; the version moves so the corrected text ships as 0.26.1.
